# Kadam Parikh

> Lead AI/ML Engineer based in Ahmedabad, India. Turns LLM prototypes into systems teams can trust: evaluation, document intelligence, voice AI and multi-agent systems. Currently Lead Engineer (AI/ML) at Simform Solutions; career in machine learning since 2019. Open to forward deployed and customer-facing AI engineering roles.

Client names are withheld, so case studies describe what was built and how it was measured. Projects built by teams Kadam led are marked "Led".
